# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnassqs)

# Create spatial references
pixel_size <- 1000
epsg <- 5070

# Get county boundaries
aoi <- tigris::counties("ID") %>%
  filter(NAME %in% c("Jefferson", "Gem", "Madison", "Clark", "Jerome", "Bonneville", "Teton", "Power", "Blaine", "Elmore", "Butte", "Adams", "Minidoka", "Bingham", "Ada", "Cassia", "Payette", "Fremont", "Bannock", "Twin Falls", "Owyhee", "Washington", "Gooding", "Lincoln", "Camas", "Canyon")) %>%
  st_transform(epsg)
```

Data to retrieve (years: 2002, 2007, 2012, 2017, 2022):

- Income, net cash farm, of operations - net income, measured in $ / operation
- average size of farms
- number of farms by [economic sales class, ownership]
- number of hired and migrant workers
- cash rent expense per acre (irrigated, non-irrigated, pasture)
- [wheat (all, winter, spring, spring durum), barley, oats, corn (grain, silage), dry edible beans, dry peas, lentils, sugarbeets, hay (all, alfalfa, other), haylage, potatoes, onions (all), hops, peppermint] harvested
- number cattle (all, beef, milk)
- acres of specialty crops (see https://www.ams.usda.gov/services/grants/scbgp/specialty-crop)

```{r}
#| label: "retrieve data"

# set API key
nassqs_auth(key = Sys.getenv('NASSQS_TOKEN'))

# create data frame for clustering
county_ag_data <- expand.grid(county = aoi$NAME,
                              year = seq(2002, 2022, 5))

# list parameters for net income
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year = unique(county_ag_data$year),
               commodity_desc = "income, net cash farm",
               short_desc = "Income, net cash farm, of operations - net income, measured in $ / operation",
               domain_desc = "total")
net_income <- nassqs(params)

# join
county_ag_data <- net_income %>%
  select(county_name, year, Value) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name",
         "net_income" = "Value") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)
```
